quote: we implemented a baseline system for automatically generating OTs from NL queries.
In the first phase, the annotator is presented with an OT ... The task of the annotator is to formulate an appropriate NL question for the sampled OT.
In this paper, we introduced a fast annotation procedure to create NL queries and corresponding database queries (in our case, Operation Trees).
outputs: Operation Trees (OTs) that can be mapped to SQL or SPARQL

quote: the baseline achieves scores of up to 48% precision

The results show that using the token assignment increases the scores by around 2%. In the case of 20% training data, the gain is even as high as 7%, thus showing that the model can benefit from the additional information that is provided in the token assignments.
